title: Arctic Council
definition: The Arctic Council is the leading intergovernmental forum promoting cooperation, coordination, and interaction among Arctic States, Arctic indigenous communities, and other inhabitants on common Arctic issues, particularly sustainable development and environmental protection.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for Environment (Climate Change), International Relations (Geopolitics of the Arctic), and Geography (Polar regions). UPSC frequently tests India's status, membership criteria, and the impact of melting ice on global climate.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Arctic Council.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
